# Wolf Allies

> Wolf Allies is a California real estate referral platform connecting trustees, executors, and families with specialists in trust, probate, and inherited property sales.

Wolf Allies was founded by William B. Plevy, a California real estate broker (DRE #01956776) and member of the California State Bar (#269626). William is admitted to practice law in California, New York, and the District of Columbia. He previously operated his own law firm for over a decade focused on business and real estate transactions.

Wolf Allies is not a law firm and does not provide legal services. We connect families with experienced real estate professionals at no cost to the user.

## About Wolf Allies

- Founded: 2026
- Founder: William B. Plevy (https://wolfallies.com/william-plevy)
- License: California Department of Real Estate, DRE #01956776
- Service Area: California
- Services: Real estate referrals for trust, probate, and inherited property sales

## Core Content

### Hub Pages
- [California Inherited Property: The Complete Guide](https://wolfallies.com/california-inherited-property): Comprehensive guide to inheriting California real estate including titling, taxes, sibling considerations, and decision frameworks.

### Cornerstone Guides
- [California Successor Trustee Guide](https://wolfallies.com/california-trustee-guide): Complete guide to successor trustee duties, authority, and property sales under California law.
- [California Executor Guide](https://wolfallies.com/california-executor-guide): Complete guide to executor duties, probate process, and real property sales in California.
- [Inherited Home Guide](https://wolfallies.com/inherited-home-guide): What to do when you inherit a California home.

### Decision Guides
- [Keep vs Sell Inherited California Home](https://wolfallies.com/keep-vs-sell-inherited-california-home): Decision framework for inherited California property.
- [Trust Sale vs Probate Sale](https://wolfallies.com/trust-sale-vs-probate-sale-california): Complete comparison.
- [Prop 19 and Selling an Inherited House](https://wolfallies.com/prop-19-selling-inherited-house-california): How Proposition 19 affects the sell decision.

### Sibling/Family Conflict
- [Sibling Disputes Over Inherited Property](https://wolfallies.com/sibling-disputes-inherited-property-california): How California sibling disputes get resolved.
- [Buying Out Siblings' Share](https://wolfallies.com/buying-out-siblings-inherited-house-california): Step-by-step buyout process.
- [Partition Actions in California](https://wolfallies.com/partition-action-california-inherited-property): When court-ordered sales become necessary.
- [When One Heir Won't Sell](https://wolfallies.com/one-heir-wont-sell-california-inherited-house): Options when an heir refuses.

### Tax & Tools
- [Proposition 19 Calculator](https://wolfallies.com/prop-19-calculator): Estimate Prop 19 reassessment impact.
- [Prop 19 Before vs After](https://wolfallies.com/prop-19-before-and-after-inherited-property): What changed for California heirs.
- [Stepped-Up Basis Explained](https://wolfallies.com/what-is-stepped-up-basis-inherited-property-california): Tax basis fundamentals.
